name: holz
text: You really, you never have to do things a particular way. Um, for me, I was like, it wasn't that I was against investors. I was just like, um, uh, I guess, uh, I was like, "I'm gonna use my own money first." And, um, you can do funny things, like you can loan your own money to your company, and then the company could pay you back in the future if you raise money. Like, you can do all sorts of tricks, but like, you know. I think I just, um, I spent all my money until I was like negative $1,000, and then it's very motivating to make money when you're, when you have no money left. Uh, and, uh- [laughs] ... you, you have to understand, when you raise money, sometimes the motivation to make money goes away, and then instead you get the motivation to just raise more money
